topic: Islam: Beliefs, Crime & Punishment, Living the Muslim Life, Peace & Conflict (Spec A)
subject: religious-studies

items.q: Do all religions teach that violence is always forbidden?
items.correct: Most emphasise peace, but many also discuss 'just' or defensive conflict under conditions.
items.misconception: Yes, all teach absolute non-violence with no exceptions.
items.why: Teachings range from pacifism to conditional acceptance of conflict.

items.q: Does pacifism mean doing nothing about injustice?
items.correct: No — pacifists reject violence but may actively pursue peace and justice non-violently.
items.why: Non-violent action (protest, dialogue) is central to many pacifist positions.
